The day of the final agreement is dropped, because it is not the day the alliance began. title: Franco-Russian Alliance
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Franco-Russian Alliance", at revision 1375457134, opens: "The Franco-Russian Alliance, also known as the Dual Entente or Russo-French Rapprochement, was an alliance formed by the agreements of 1891–94; it lasted until 1917. The strengthening of the German Empire, the creation of the Triple Alliance of 1882, and the exacerbation of Franco-German and Russo-German tensions at the end of the 1880s led to a common foreign policy and mutual strategic military interests between France and Russia. The development of financial ties between the two countries created the economic prerequisites for the Russo-French Alliance." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q243799, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military alliance". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
